cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Tell me you understand why six weeks of silence hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. For me, the silence didn't come with a repair notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Can you understand why I kept rewriting a message you'd never answered, trying to become easier to reply to?

mechanism: A corrects an equipment explanation into the personal meaning of silence, then narrows a broad caring acknowledgement to its sustained emotional cost.
confusable: D74 retains someone until repair; D75 asks explicit recognition of emotional impact, not necessarily continued presence.
comparison: Concert alternative uses a recording detail; silence alternative uses repeated unsent or unanswered-message work to show felt inadequacy.
seedUse: Broken phone, six weeks silence, stopped-caring interpretation and rewritten message derive from D75-b; S03 adds precise explanation-versus-effect corrections.
